headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas, Trilegal act on Moneyview ₹1,091 crore IPO
sum: Moneyview Limited has raised ₹1,091.68 crore from its initial public offering of equity shares, comprising a fresh issue and an offer for sale by the promoters and certain institutional investors Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised…
detail: Moneyview Limited has raised ₹1,091.68 crore from its initial public offering of equity shares, comprising a fresh issue and an offer for sale by the promoters and certain institutional investors Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised Moneyview on this IPO. The Capital Markets team comprised Prashant Gupta (National Practice Head, Capital Markets), Ruth Chenchiah (Partner), Harini Jambunathan (Senior Associate), Anoushka PV (Senior Associate) and Anaya Jain (Associate). The Fintech team comprised Shilpa Mankar Ahluwalia (Co-Head, Banking & Finance), Shubhangi Garg (Partner), Indraneel Godsay (Senior Associate) and Sandeep Grewal (Senior Associate).
